title: Probabilistic failover mixer and circuit steering patch
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: During the recent regional surge we observed correlated failovers where multiple nodes flipped into degraded states simultaneously. This caused cascading client failovers and abrupt capacity loss. This PR introduces a probabilistic failover mixer that spreads failover decisions across compatible candidates and a lightweight circuit-steering layer that reduces request affinity to nodes that are repeatedly flapping.

What changed (high level):
- Add failover mixer algorithm (serving/failover/mixer.go) that samples candidate nodes using weighted randomness keyed by SLO slack and recent error history. The mixer favors stable nodes but allows controlled probabilistic routing to avoid global synchronized moves.
- Add circuit steering shim (serving/circuit/steering.go) which marks nodes with transient flaps and adjusts routing scores for new incoming requests for a configurable cooldown window.
- Expose two new config knobs in config/defaults.yaml: failover.mixer_enabled (bool) and failover.mixer_entropy_ms (int) for temporal jitter.
- Add telemetry hooks (telemetry/metrics.go) to emit mixer.choice, steering.flags, and per-node-flap counters. These metrics are tagged by region/zone and rollout-stage.
- Tests: unit tests for mixer logic and steering heuristics (tests/failover/mixer_test.go).
- Docs: ops runbook for probabilistic failover and steering behavior (docs/ops/failover.md).

Hotfix rationale: This landed as a hotfix because synchronized failovers are a major reliability pain during regional surges; the mixer reduces blast radius without changing core eviction logic. The steering shim prevents oscillation by temporarily de-prioritizing flapping nodes for new sessions.

Checklist:
- [x] Design reviewed with SRE and Serving Runtime (ENG-2451)
- [x] Unit tests added and passing locally
- [x] Telemetry defined and validated in staging
- [x] Feature gated behind failover.mixer_enabled (default: false)
- [x] Ops runbook added for rollback and metrics thresholds

Testing and rollout plan:
1) Deploy to canary in us-west-2 with mixer_enabled=false + telemetry only, validate metrics baseline for 24h.
2) Enable mixer_enabled=true for 5% of regional traffic, monitor mixer.choice distribution, per-node flap counters and SLOs.
3) Gradually increase to 25% then 100% while keeping steering.cooldown_ms conservative.
4) If per-region SLO regressions > 0.5% or new error spike observed, flip feature flag off and rollback.

CI notes: initial CI run surfaced a nondeterministic test timeout in tests/failover/mixer_test.go which was fixed by reducing reliance on wall-clock timers and using deterministic pseudo-random seed injection.

Related: Linear ENG-2451, ENG-2470. See internal incident notes: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2451/regional-failover-correlation
